cards.title: Exempt from the floor, not from status
items: A reversal may leave the account below its floor — that is a real, readable debt
The account status gate and amount ceiling still apply in the reversal direction

cards.title: Two events, one save
items: The reversing posting's postings.created and the original's postings.updated are both raised from the one SaveChanges call that links them

cards.title: Checks and outcomes
items: POST /v1/postings/{id}/reverse: Requires reason in the body and Idempotency-Key in the header
none — proceed: Same key + same original id and reason replays the earlier reversal with 200. Same key + different original id or reason: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT. Missing reason or key: 400.
Status == Posted: Refused: 422 POSTING_ALREADY_REVERSED if already reversed; 422 POSTING_IS_REVERSAL if this row is itself a reversal

TryApplyPosting(opposite direction, isReversal: true) — floor check skipped, status gate still applies: Refused per the account's status in the reversal's own direction: 422 ACCOUNT_CLOSED / ACCOUNT_FROZEN / ACCOUNT_DORMANT_DEBIT_REFUSED

cards.title: Local reversal checks
items: ReversePostingCommandHandler reads original.AccountId without tracking before taking its account lock
Inside the lock it re-reads the original, refuses POSTING_ALREADY_REVERSED or POSTING_IS_REVERSAL, then loads the account
Account.TryApplyPosting applies the opposite direction with isReversal=true: the floor is skipped, but status and amount ceiling still apply
